metadata.summary: Lewis Hamilton has responded to reports he has called for changes at Ferrari after two difficult weekends at Monza and Madrid.
metadata.content: Lewis Hamilton responds to reports he has asked for Ferrari personnel changes ahead of Azerbaijan Grand Prix | F1 News | Sky Sports Skip to content Lewis Hamilton responds to reports he has asked for Ferrari personnel changes ahead of Azerbaijan Grand Prix Lewis Hamilton took to social media on Thursday to "clear up" reports claiming he has asked for personnel changes at Ferrari; watch every session of the Azerbaijan Grand Prix from September 24-26 with a Saturday race, live on Sky Sports F1 Nigel Chiu Sports Journalist @NigelCJourno Thursday 17 September 2026 17:19, UK Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player Lewis Hamilton explains what might have caused his early retirement at the Spanish Grand Prix Lewis Hamilton has responded to reports he has called for changes at Ferrari after two difficult weekends at Monza and Madrid. Hamilton has fallen 101 points behind championship leader Kimi Antonelli with nine rounds to go, having scored just eight points in the last two races. Ferrari brought an upgraded engine to their home event at the Italian Grand Prix but Hamilton only finished sixth, while Charles Leclerc crashed out, before a brake problem caused Hamilton to suffer his first retirement of the season in Madrid. Breach and Matthews, both of whom played major roles in 2025's Women's Rugby World Cup glory - as England beat Canada in the final - come into the side on the right wing and at No 8 respectively. Mitchell's side face Canada in Tests on Saturday in Exeter, Friday October 16 in Toronto, and Friday October 23 in Ottawa.
